text:
riley: Hey team, first morning and stuck. Okta asks me to register a passkey but my phone shows "No compatible authenticators". Also 1Password link says "email already in use" when I try to accept. Who do I ping?
it-help: Hi @riley, welcome! :wave: For the passkey, try clearing browser site data for okta.redwood.com and register via the Okta app on iOS/Android. If that fails, register a security key (USB) as a fallback.
riley: Tried Okta app, same error. Browser cleared.
people-ops: @riley which email did the 1Password invite go to? If personal, we can reassign. We'll also confirm the seat count.
riley: It was sent to riley.personal+dev@gmail.com by mistake. Can you resend to riley@redwood.com?
people-ops: Created PEOPLE-4902 to transfer the seat and resent invite to riley@redwood.com. Accept and reply here.
it-help: If passkey still fails, bring phone to IT and we can register a temporary security key or enable SMS OTP as a short-term fallback for SSO.
riley: Accepted new 1Password invite. Passkey still failing on my phone; will bring phone by IT. Thanks folks!
